firstPlayerRule: Choose the starting player however you wish. The main setup suggests the person who most recently built something; the quick reference says to choose at random.
clarifications: Give the chosen player the Active Player Token and Action Selection Card.
The main setup and quick reference use different examples, so neither is treated as the only permitted method.
